title: 334章 伪作归正，暗流噬广宁
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

广宁巡抚府正堂肃穆森严，堂内寂静无声，唯有烛火静静摇曳，衬得公堂愈发沉肃。

王化贞安坐公案之后，目光沉沉落于阶下跪伏的孙得功，声线沉稳，带着几分居高临下的威严：

“得功，密通辽阳之事，李永芳可有确切回音？”

孙得功连忙躬身叩首，姿态恭谨肃穆：

“回抚台，李永芳已然应允反正。其言只需我大明王师自广宁出师，直逼辽阳，后金守军若出城迎战，他便即刻于城内举事，诛杀虏酋、拨乱反正，重归大明版图。只是此人尚有两桩诉求，恳请抚台恩准。”

“如实道来。”王化贞抬眸，神色淡然，眉宇间尽是胸有成竹之态。

孙得功定了定神，将李永芳的条件一一转述：

“其一，李永芳自陈，此番归明之心恳切，无关成败。只求抚台保全其阖家老小、一世荣华，严禁熊廷弼与朝中诸臣，日后借故追责、罗织罪名、刁难其身家。

其二，他恳请抚台敲定精准出师时日，容他暗中联络旧部、排布内应、稳住辽阳局势。其称大军压境关乎生死，若是王师兵临城下，城内接应尚未筹备妥当，非但复辽大计功亏一篑，他自身亦是死无葬身之地。”

王化贞听罢，垂眸默然思忖片刻，心中已然洞悉一切。

李永芳终究是贰臣降将，行事首重身家安稳，一生贪恋权势富贵。所谓讨要出师时日、提前周密筹备，看似谨慎稳妥，实则处处私心，只为给自己预留进退之路。一旦举事败露，便可抽身潜逃，保全性命。

可正是这份赤裸裸的私欲贪念，彻底消解了王化贞心中的疑虑与戒备。

乱世官场，人心叵测。但凡有欲有求、有贪有念之人，皆有软肋可握，可控可驭。反之，若一名内应毫无私心、无所诉求，一味怂恿大军轻进冒攻，看似赤诚忠义，实则暗藏滔天阴谋，杀机深藏。

一念至此，王化贞望向阶下孙得功的目光，满是赏识与全然的信赖。

孙得功绝非庸碌偏裨，乃是他亲自主持边务时，从辽东边军底层发掘、破格拔擢的骁勇悍将。昔日沈阳保卫战，他追随贺世贤登城死战，屡次杀出重围，力挫后金精锐。贺世贤殉国、沈阳沦陷之后，他兵败溃散却宁死不降，辗转千里退守辽阳。

辽阳再战，他依旧披甲执戈、身先士卒，浴血死守城池，直至兵溃城破，方才拼死突围，历尽艰险奔赴广宁，始终守着大明将官的忠义底线。

屡经辽东血战，数度败而不降、死战不退，这般忠勇坚韧、悍不畏死的良将，世间难得。

自王化贞于御前上奏复辽方略，得兵部全力扶持，调拨兵马粮草、委以边地重任以来，他虽手握辽西军政大权，身负复辽重任，却终究是文臣出身，不熟军旅实务、战守机宜。

是孙得功，替他补齐了所有短板缺憾。

广宁粮草屯储要害、城防修筑关键、后金骑兵作战习性、辽东山川地势、攻守进退之法，凡边境实情、军务机要，皆由孙得功悉心梳理、逐一禀报，面面俱到、毫无疏漏。正因有此人辅佐铺垫，王化贞方能在朝堂百官面前，立住通晓兵略、深谙边事的能臣形象，稳稳推行自己的复辽之策。

王化贞素来惜才爱才，早已将孙得功视作心腹肱骨，破格擢升其为游击将军，令其独领一军，大小边事多有咨商。此番暗中联络辽地降将、筹划内应反正的绝密要务，他更是全权托付孙得功一手督办。

数月暗中斡旋、隐秘往来，李永芳归正大计终见曙光，不日便可收获盖世大功。

Page (1/3)

The main hall of the Guangning Governor's Mansion is solemn and solemn, and there is silence in the hall. Only the candlelight flickers quietly, making the court even more solemn.

After Wang Huazhen sat down in public, his eyes fell heavily on Sun Degong, who was kneeling at the foot of the stairs. His voice was calm, with a bit of condescending dignity:

"Thank you for your secret communication with Liaoyang. Does Li Yongfang have a definite response?"

Sun Degong quickly bowed and kowtowed, his posture was respectful and solemn:

"Returning to Futai, Li Yongfang has agreed to do it anyway. He said that as long as my army of the Ming Dynasty marches from Guangning and goes straight to Liaoyang, and if the Jin garrison comes out of the city to fight, he will immediately launch an attack in the city to kill the captive chiefs, bring order to the chaos, and return to the Ming Dynasty. But this person still has two demands, and I sincerely ask Futai for permission."

"Tell it truthfully." Wang Huazhen raised his eyes, his expression was calm, and his brows were full of confidence.

Sun Degong composed himself and recounted Li Yongfang's conditions one by one:

"First, Li Yongfang confesses that he is sincere in his return to the Ming Dynasty, regardless of success or failure. He only asks Futai to protect his family and his prosperity, and strictly prohibits Xiong Tingbi and other ministers in the court from using excuses to hold him accountable, make accusations, and make things difficult for him in the future.

Secondly, he implored Futai to finalize the precise date for the departure of troops, allowing him to secretly contact his old troops, arrange internal responses, and stabilize the situation in Liaoyang.He said that the army's pressure on the border was a matter of life and death. If Wang's troops came to the city and the response in the city was not well prepared, not only would the plan to restore Liao be in vain, but he himself would also die without a burial place."

After Wang Huazhen listened, he lowered his eyes and thought silently for a moment, knowing everything in his heart.

After all, Li Yongfang is a second-in-command, his first priority is the security of his family, and he has been greedy for power and wealth all his life.The so-called asking for a departure date and making careful preparations in advance may seem prudent and prudent, but in fact they are all selfish, just to reserve a way forward and retreat for oneself.Once the incident is exposed, he can escape and save his life.

But it was this naked lust and greed that completely dispelled Wang Huazhen's doubts and wariness.

In the troubled times of officialdom, people's hearts are unpredictable.Anyone who has desires, desires, greed and thoughts will have weaknesses that can be grasped, controlled and controlled.On the other hand, if a spy has no selfish motives or appeals, and just encourages the army to attack lightly, it may look like he is sincere and loyal, but in fact he is hiding a huge conspiracy and a murderous intention.

As soon as he thought about this, Wang Huazhen looked at Sun Degong down the stairs, his eyes full of appreciation and complete trust.

Sun Degong was by no means a mediocre person. He was a brave general who was discovered and promoted from the bottom of the Liaodong border army when he personally took charge of border affairs.In the past defense battle of Shenyang, he followed He Shixian to the city to fight to the death, breaking out of the siege many times and defeating the elite of the Later Jin Dynasty.After He Shixian died for his country and Shenyang fell, he was defeated and routed but would rather die than surrender. He traveled thousands of miles and retreated to Liaoyang.

When Liaoyang fought again, he still wore armor, took the lead, and defended the city with blood. Until the army was defeated and the city was defeated, he finally broke through and went through hardships and dangers to Guangning, always guarding the bottom line of loyalty of the Ming Dynasty generals.

After many bloody battles in Liaodong, he was defeated several times without surrender, and fought to the death without retreating. Such a loyal, brave, tenacious, and fearless general is rare in the world.

Ever since Wang Huazhen presented the strategy for restoring the Liao Dynasty to the emperor and received full support from the Ministry of War, allocating troops, horses, food and fodder, and entrusting the border areas with important responsibilities, although he held the military and political power in western Liaoning and was responsible for the important task of restoring the Liao Dynasty, he was still a civil servant and was not familiar with military practices and tactics.

It was Sun Degong who made up for all his shortcomings.

The key points of Guangning's grain and grass garrison, the key points of city defense construction, the combat habits of the Later Jin cavalry, the mountains and rivers of Liaodong, the methods of offensive and defensive advance and retreat, and all the actual border conditions and military secrets were all carefully sorted out and reported one by one by Sun Degong, with no omissions or omissions.It was precisely because of this person's assistance and paving the way that Wang Huazhen was able to establish his image as a capable minister who knew military strategies and was well versed in side affairs in front of all the officials in the court, and was able to steadily implement his strategy of restoring the Liao Dynasty.

Wang Huazhen always cherishes talents and has long regarded Sun Degong as a confidant. He promoted him to the rank of guerrilla general and made him lead an army alone. He consulted on many major and minor affairs.This time, he secretly contacted the Liao generals and planned the top-secret task of responding to the enemy, and he entrusted Sun Degong with full authority to supervise it.

After months of secret mediation and secret dealings, Li Yongfang's plan to return to justice has finally come to light, and he will soon achieve great success.
